title: TaskConfig v2
description: Schema for schemaVersion 2 *.taskconfig.json artifacts (kind: task_config). A v2 config binds a task code to a workflow artifact id; the officer's forms and review behavior are defined by that workflow's own artifacts rather than inline in the task config.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version of this task_config artifact. This schema covers version 2; see taskconfig.v1.schema.json for version 1.

taskCode.description: Logical task type this config applies to, e.g. 'cda_officer_verification_v1'. If omitted, the artifact's manifest id is used as the effective task code instead.

workflow.description: Id of the workflow artifact (kind: workflow) that drives this task, e.g. 'cda_officer_verification_v1'.

title.description: Shown in the task list and as the review screen header.

description.description: One-line subtitle shown under the title.

icon.description: Icon hint. The frontend currently only renders 'emoji:<char>'-prefixed values; anything else is ignored.

category.description: Grouping label shown in the task list, e.g. 'Food Control'.
